title: Gorgeous intact medieval monastery
text: My young Irish driver was charming, well-traveled and knowledgeable. He was also an excellent careful driver. The drive to Poblet Abbey was scenic and we had a gorgeous day. The abbey was of particular interest to me; the tour company made sure that Poblet was the highlight of my day, even though I was touring alone. The electronic introduction to the abbey was especially good, as it covered both the very long history of the monastery as well as life with an active monastic life. Also, because I was travelling alone, I was able to spend extra time in the museum at Poblet and stop for a coffee.
author: Karen_B
